issues.t: Cracked fuel injector can leak gasoline (recall)
issues.sym: A strong smell of raw gasoline from under the hood, a check-engine light, or rough running. In the worst case, smoke or fire in the engine bay.
issues.why: One or more high-pressure fuel injectors on the 1.5L engine can crack and drip fuel onto hot engine parts. Ford has recalled these SUVs several times, first adding leak-detection software and a drain tube, and later replacing the fuel rail and injectors.
issues.next: If you smell fuel, park outside, shut the engine off and call a Ford dealer. Check your VIN for open recalls; some SUVs that were already fixed need the newer repair.

issues.t: Coolant pump leak and low coolant
issues.sym: Pink or yellow coolant drips or puddles under the front of the SUV, a low-coolant warning, loss of cabin heat, or the temperature gauge climbing.
issues.why: The engine coolant (water) pump on the 1.5L engine can start leaking. Ford says contamination in the cooling system is a likely cause, so the fix includes a full flush, not just a new pump.
issues.next: Keep an eye on the coolant level and do not drive if it is overheating. Ask a Ford dealer about bulletin 25-2063 (and later versions); if you are still under warranty the repair should be covered.

issues.t: 12V battery can fail suddenly and cut power (recalls)
issues.sym: Slow cranking or no start, warning messages about the battery or charging system, accessories shutting off, and in some cases a loss of drive power while driving.
issues.why: The body and engine control modules may not notice when the 12V battery is getting weak, and some batteries degrade and fail without warning. Ford recalled these SUVs to reprogram the modules and check or replace the battery, and redid some earlier repairs.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recalls 24V-267, 24V-683, 25V-019 and 25V-158. If the battery is more than 3 years old or the SUV is slow to start, have the battery tested.

issues.t: Front ball joint can separate from the knuckle (do-not-drive recall)
issues.sym: Clunking or knocking from the front end, loose or wandering steering, or uneven tire wear. If it separates, a front wheel can fold under the vehicle.
issues.why: Some front lower control arm ball joints may have been installed or repaired incorrectly and can pull out of the steering knuckle. Ford told owners not to drive the SUV until it is inspected.
issues.next: Do not drive it until it has been inspected. Check your VIN for recall 26V-340 and ask the dealer about towing or a loaner.

issues.t: Oil separator housing can crack and leak oil (recall)
issues.sym: Burning oil smell, smoke from under the hood, oil on the engine or under the SUV, or a low oil warning.
issues.why: On the 1.5L engine the plastic oil separator housing (part of the crankcase ventilation system) can crack and let oil drip onto the hot exhaust, which is a fire risk.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 22V-191. If you see smoke or smell burning oil, pull over and turn the engine off.

issues.t: Rear drive unit low on oil can seize (recall)
issues.sym: Whining or grinding from the rear on AWD models, or in the worst case the rear wheels lock up suddenly.
issues.why: Some rear drive units (rear differentials) were filled with too little gear oil at the factory, which can overheat and seize them.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 21V-011. If you hear new noises from the rear, have it checked before driving far.

issues.t: Transmission slips when hot pulling away from a stop
issues.sym: After the SUV is fully warmed up, the engine revs flare or it feels like it slips when you accelerate from a stop.
issues.why: Ford found that some 8-speed automatic transmissions (8F35) built before mid-March 2022 can lose pressure when hot. Its fix is a new transmission pump seal.
issues.next: Tell the dealer exactly when it happens and mention Ford service message SSM 51011. Repairs should be covered while the powertrain warranty is in effect.

issues.t: AWD chatter or shudder in slow tight turns
issues.sym: Chattering, binding or shuddering from underneath when turning sharply at parking-lot speeds or backing up.
issues.why: The rear drive unit clutches on AWD models can grab and release unevenly. Ford issued service message SSM 51823 for it; a fluid change in the rear drive unit usually helps.
issues.next: Have a dealer check the rear drive unit fluid and ask about SSM 51823. It is not usually dangerous, but do not ignore grinding.

issues.t: Weak A/C with coolant spills and popping under the hood
issues.sym: A/C does not cool well, popping, knocking or hissing sounds from the engine bay, a little smoke, or coolant stains around the engine.
issues.why: Ford service message SSM 51724 covers 1.5L Bronco Sports with weak A/C plus under-hood noises and coolant spills. These often trace back to the cooling system rather than the A/C itself.
issues.next: Have a dealer check both the A/C system and the coolant level, and mention SSM 51724.

issues.t: Engine block heater can crack and short out (recall)
issues.sym: Coolant leaking near the block heater, a tripped outlet when it is plugged in, or a burning smell.
issues.why: The factory engine block heater can crack, leak coolant and short-circuit when plugged in, which is a fire risk.
issues.next: Do not plug in the block heater until the recall is done. Check your VIN for recall 25V-685.

issues.t: Engine block heater can overheat when plugged in (recall)
issues.sym: A hot or burning smell near the front of the SUV or at the cord while the block heater is plugged in.
issues.why: The block heater element on newer models can overheat when it is in use. Ford recalled 2025 models and then added 2026 models.
issues.next: Stop using the block heater until the dealer replaces it. Check your VIN for recalls 25V-343 and 26V-239.

issues.t: Backup camera blank or stays on (recall)
issues.sym: The backup camera picture is blank when you shift into reverse, or the camera image stays on screen after you shift out of reverse.
issues.why: A software problem in the camera and infotainment system. Ford fixes it with a software update.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 25V-442. Use your mirrors and look behind you until it is fixed.

issues.t: Fuel pump module can leak in the tank and stall (recall)
issues.sym: Hard starting, hesitation, loss of power, or the engine stalling while driving.
issues.why: The fuel delivery module inside the gas tank can leak internally, so the engine does not get enough fuel pressure.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 21V-625. If it stalls, get to a safe spot and have it towed to a dealer.

issues.t: Brake pads may not stop as well as designed (recall)
issues.sym: The brakes may feel weaker than normal or take longer to stop the SUV.
issues.why: Some brake linings were made incorrectly and do not meet federal braking standards. Ford recalled the SUVs to replace the pads.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 21V-922 and get the pads replaced. Leave extra stopping distance until then.

issues.t: Moonroof glass may not be bonded and could come off (recall)
issues.sym: You may notice wind noise or a loose-looking moonroof panel, but often there is no warning.
issues.why: On some 2021 models the moonroof glass was not bonded to its frame correctly and could separate while driving.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 21V-809. The dealer checks the glass date code and replaces it if needed.

issues.t: Front control arms or rear subframe bolts may be faulty (recalls)
issues.sym: Clunks over bumps, a loose feeling in the front or rear end, or the SUV pulling to one side.
issues.why: Some early 2021 models had front lower control arms built incorrectly (recall 21V-074) or rear subframe bolts that were loose or missing (recall 21V-075).
issues.next: Check your VIN for both recalls. Have any new clunks checked right away.

issues.t: Fuel pump control module bracket can loosen and stall the engine (recall)
issues.sym: The engine may stall while driving or refuse to start.
issues.why: A bracket holding the fuel pump control module may not be secured, letting the module fail. Ford replaces the fuel tank assembly.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 22V-787.

issues.t: Parking lights flicker with the headlights on (recall)
issues.sym: The parking lights flicker when the headlights are switched on.
issues.why: An LED driver module can make the lights flicker, which does not meet federal lighting rules.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 22V-686.

issues.t: Daytime running lights stay on
issues.sym: The daytime running lights stay on after the SUV is turned off, or do not shut off as expected.
issues.why: The LED lighting control module on Bronco Sports built before November 2022 can misbehave. Ford issued bulletin 23-2267 for it.
issues.next: Ask a dealer about bulletin 23-2267. Lights left on can also drain the 12V battery.

issues.t: ABS module can leak inside and lengthen pedal travel (recall)
issues.sym: The brake pedal goes down farther than normal or the SUV takes longer to stop.
issues.why: Valves inside the anti-lock brake (ABS) module may be damaged and leak internally.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 23V-021 and do not delay. Leave extra stopping distance until it is fixed.

issues.t: Windshield wipers can stop working (recall)
issues.sym: The wipers slow down, stop partway, or do not work at all.
issues.why: The front wiper motor may fail. Ford recalled 2023 and 2024 models to inspect and replace it.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 24V-594. Do not drive in rain or snow if the wipers fail.

issues.t: Tires may have a manufacturing defect (recall)
issues.sym: Bulges, vibration or unusual wear on the original tires.
issues.why: Some factory-installed tires were not made correctly, which can hurt handling.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 24V-223. The dealer inspects and replaces tires if needed.

issues.t: Engine may not restart after auto start-stop
issues.sym: At a stop the engine shuts off as normal but does not restart when you lift off the brake, sometimes with a check-engine light.
issues.why: Ford service message SSM 51613 covers 2022-2023 models built in late 2022 that may store code P164C and fail to restart after auto start-stop.
issues.next: Put it in Park and restart with the button if needed. Ask a dealer about SSM 51613.

issues.t: Check-engine light from a failed purge valve
issues.sym: Check-engine light, sometimes with a rough idle or hard start after filling up.
issues.why: The vapor management (purge) valve, which controls gasoline vapors from the fuel tank, can stick or fail. Owners report it around 39,000 miles.
issues.next: Have the codes read. Replacing the valve is a fairly simple repair.

issues.t: Center touchscreen stops working
issues.sym: The touchscreen goes black, freezes or does not respond to touch.
issues.why: Owners report the infotainment screen failing at low mileage. Software updates or a new screen module usually fix it.
issues.next: Restart the SUV and check for software updates. If it keeps happening, have a dealer diagnose it under warranty.

issues.t: Cylinder head plugs can leak oil (recall)
issues.sym: Oil on the engine or under the SUV, burning oil smell, or a low oil warning.
issues.why: Some cylinder heads were made with ball plugs that may not seal and can leak oil.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 25V-372. If you smell burning oil, stop and have it checked.

issues.t: Instrument cluster can go dark (recalls)
issues.sym: The gauges and warning lights do not light up when you start the SUV or while driving, so you cannot see your speed.
issues.why: Some instrument clusters may fail at startup. Ford replaces the cluster on some 2025 models (25V-049) and updates software on others (25V-788).
issues.next: Check your VIN for both recalls. Do not drive if you cannot see your speed and warnings.

issues.t: EGR valve can fail and cut engine power (recall)
issues.sym: Sudden loss of power, the SUV going into a reduced-power mode, and a check-engine light.
issues.why: The exhaust gas recirculation (EGR) valve may fail, which can cause a loss of drive power.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 26V-122 and follow Ford's instructions while you wait for the repair.

issues.t: Passenger airbag sensor may misread who is in the seat (recall)
issues.sym: The passenger airbag status light may show the wrong state for who is sitting there.
issues.why: The passenger seat occupant classification sensor may not detect the person correctly, so the airbag may not deploy as it should.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 26V-201. Keep children in the back seat.

issues.t: Pistons may be made wrong and fail (recall)
issues.sym: Knocking, misfires, loss of power or the engine quitting.
issues.why: Some pistons may have been made with the wrong top (dome) shape, which can lead to engine failure.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 26V-548. The dealer inspects the pistons and replaces the engine long block if needed.

issues.t: Body or suspension joints may be loose (recall)
issues.sym: Rattles, clunks or a loose feeling while driving.
issues.why: Some bolted joints may not have been tightened properly at the factory, so parts could come loose.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 26V-550.
